## Overview

This project brings the measurement pipeline and peripheral interfaces
together in a production-oriented embedded system architecture.

## Implementation

- Combined ADC acquisition with SPI and I2C sensor interfaces.
- Organized processing and communication into RTOS-managed tasks.
- Planned buffers and telemetry for predictable operation and diagnostics.

## Outcome
